calls.title: Growthbook <> Goodnotes - Pricing Review
calls.summary: The meeting focused on finalizing the pricing structure for Growth Book’s deployments, which proposed a three-tier model with flat fees and discounts for larger user groups, designed for flexibility and budget ease. Clarifications were made regarding user count and additional pricing, easing financial commitment concerns. Vaida raised budget limits compared to the current costs, while Dan highlighted long-term value in adopting fixed fees. The team emphasized the importance of aligning deployment timelines with contract expirations and fostering effective communication through Slack for rapid feedback. They aimed for a phased rollout strategy that begins in May, with discussions around scaling to accommodate larger teams.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Amplitude, Static, Pricing, Deployment Options, Self-Hosted
